title: Information-Theoretic Testing and Debugging of Fairness Defects in Deep Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper presents a technical testing and debugging framework (DICE) designed to quantify and localize individual discrimination in deep neural networks using information theory. While algorithmic fairness is a subset of AI ethics, the paper's focus is on technical software engineering and information-theoretic metrics rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or philosophical systems.
